description: COLUMBUS, Ohio (WKBN) – State Representative Al Cutrona (R-Canfield) announced Tuesday that $1,651,370 has been awarded for a project in Mahoning County.The funds will go towards construction at the Ohio State Penitentiary in Youngstown.“These funds will help update facilities and ensure they operate in a healthy and safe manner,” said Cutrona. “Investing in these renovations now saves taxpayer dollars and prevents larger, costlier problems down the road.”The State Controlling Board approved the
title: State Rep. announces $1.65M for project in Mahoning County
